tasks.label: CMake: Configure
tasks.detail: Configures the default build: matches ngen CI's test_unit job (NetCDF/UDUNITS/SQLite on, BMI-C/Python/MPI off). See ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md to enable the optional components.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Full: BMI-C + Python)
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: also enables BMI-C (pulls in TOPMODEL/CFE/PET/LGAR extern models) and embedded Python. Requires extern/pybind11 to be initialized first — see ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md.

tasks.label: Setup: Build Boost with serialization (UEB)
tasks.detail: One-time setup for UEB: builds and installs a compiled Boost (with the serialization component) to /opt/boost-built. The default image only has Boost headers at $BOOST_ROOT. Run this once before using the UEB configure task.

tasks.label: Setup: Build and install EWTS (UEB)
args: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gfortran libopenmpi-dev openmpi-bin && cmake -B /tmp/ewts-build -S extern/ewts -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DEWTS_WITH_NGEN=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-I${env:BOOST_ROOT}" && cmake --build /tmp/ewts-build -j $(nproc) && cmake --install /tmp/ewts-build --prefix /opt/ewts
tasks.detail: One-time setup for UEB: installs gfortran/MPI dev libs, then builds and installs EWTS (UEB's hard find_package(ewts) dependency) to /opt/ewts. Configures from extern/ewts (the root CMakeLists.txt with the real project()/VERSION), not extern/ewts/runtime as upstream's INSTALL.md says — the runtime-only configure has no project() and fails at write_basic_package_version_file. Also passes Boost's headers via CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS since EWTS's ngen bridge includes boost/property_tree but never calls find_package(Boost) itself. Run this once before using the UEB configure task, after the Boost setup task.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Full: BMI-C + Python + UEB)
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: everything in the BMI-C + Python task, plus UEB (bmi_c++ snow model). Requires a compiled Boost (with serialization) installed to /opt/boost-built and EWTS installed to /opt/ewts first — see the UEB section of ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md. Also forces CMP0057=NEW and pre-supplies NETCDF_C_LIB_DIR/NETCDF_C_INCLUDE_DIR, working around two bugs in extern/ueb-bmi's own CMakeLists.txt that otherwise break NetCDF detection when NGEN_WITH_NETCDF is on.

tasks.label: Build ngen (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds the ngen driver executable and the test_bmi_cpp shared library the example realization config in data/ loads.

tasks.label: Build test_unit (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds the test_unit and test_geopackage suites (mirrors ngen CI's test_unit job).

tasks.label: Build test binary (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds an arbitrary test target by name. Used as the preLaunchTask for the generic 'Debug a test binary' launch config — see ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md.

tasks.label: Rebuild ngen
tasks.detail: Clean, then a full fresh configure + build.

inputs.description: CMake target name to build, which is also the resulting test binary name under cmake_build/test/ (see test/CMakeLists.txt for the full list, e.g. test_partition, test_nexus, test_geojson, test_mdarray, test_logging). Must match what you enter for the launch config's own prompt.
